title: MCPToolDefinition
description: Contract for a single tool inside a Generated MCP Server Package. Field names match the MCP tool schema (name/description/inputSchema/outputSchema/annotations) so any MCP-compatible AI tool consumes it with no custom mapping.

name.description: Unique tool name within the generated server.

description.description: Human- and model-readable summary of what invoking this tool does (FR-003).

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema describing the tool's call arguments, derived from DiscoveredFunctionality.parameters.

outputSchema.description: JSON Schema describing the tool's result shape, when known.

readOnlyHint.description: true when the underlying functionality only reads data (FR-007).

destructiveHint.description: true when invoking this tool can destructively change or remove data.

idempotentHint.description: true when repeating this call has the same effect as calling it once; gates automatic retry (research.md #5).

includedByDefault.description: false for mutating tools unless the user explicitly opts in at generation time (FR-012).

sourceIdentityKey.description: Foreign key back to the DiscoveredFunctionality this tool was generated from.

allOf.description: FR-012: a mutating tool (readOnlyHint=false) must not be included by default.
